relations: Vero 与 Brawley 是伴侣（同居、'my man'、'What my man wants, he gets'）；Brawley 极占有欲，威胁若 Vero 让别的男人碰他就要杀了那人
Vesper 是 Brawley 最好的朋友（'Vesper is Brawley’s best friend'），她理解 Brawley 对暴力的需求，且常与 Vero 互殴
Clay 与 Brawley 由情敌变成对赌的敌对关系：Brawley 说 'And Clay, I will fight you for her'，Clay 说 'Deal.'，赌注是 Vero
Ares、Kodi 与 Vero 是同一屋檐下的同事/室友：Clay 是 Ares 的 'our housemate' 但 'very closed off to anyone who isn’t one of his siblings'；Brawley 令 'Tonight, get Kodi to cover you'

numbers: got one all the way in

facts.fact: Vero 向 Brawley 描述昨晚遇到的女孩——就是 Clay 在跟踪的那个：棕色头发、满身纹身、眼睛蓝得发绿，并说 'Death via paper cuts makes her perfect'
facts.anchor: Fuck, she is something else—brown hair, tattoos everywhere, on her neck, arms, really pretty ones.

facts.fact: Vero 说自己为了找纸割杀人的实验对象，黑进了恋童癖数据库，又跑去怪人博物馆找 Banks 要毒药
facts.anchor: First, I went on and hacked the database for pedophiles—what better person to be my test subject?

facts.fact: Banks 拒绝做毒药、也拒绝做 Clay 的人皮 voodoo 娃娃，改为答应给 Vero 做一个那个女人的等身蜡像（还卖他用自己精液做的面霜）
facts.anchor: He agreed to make me a life-sized wax figure of the woman I met last night.

facts.fact: Brawley 提出让 Nixie 给那女人发邀请；Vero 问他是否愿意为此惹怒 Clay，Brawley 说气 Clay 是他最大的乐趣、但他什么都愿为 Vero 做
facts.anchor: This woman, should we ask Nixie to send her an invitation?”

facts.fact: Vero 在楼梯口向 Clay 承认那女孩就是 Clay 一直在跟踪的人并说 'I want her. She gets me.'，Clay 当场回 'No!'
facts.anchor: “Fine, it’s the girl you were following. I want her. She gets me.”

facts.fact: Brawley 揪住 Vero 的头发后仰、吻他，并宣布 'And Clay, I will fight you for her'；Ares 提议 Clay 若赢了就能操 Vero，Brawley 扑向 Ares，Clay 答 'Deal.'
facts.anchor: “Behave. And Clay, I will fight you for her. What my man wants, he gets.”

facts.fact: Brawley 威胁 Vero：若让他碰 Clay，就让他看着自己杀掉 Clay、再在尸体上操他、然后杀掉他；Vero 反将一军要 Brawley 必须赢，否则就得看着 Clay 操他
facts.anchor: “If you let him fuck you, I will make you watch me kill him. Next, I will fuck you on his dead body, and only then will I kill you.”

facts.fact: Vero 取出橙色囚服连体衣（腰间带连着手铐）和 Hannibal 面具，决定先去跟 Nixie 谈，再看自己的男人把 Clay 打成猪头
facts.anchor: I plan to get ready, talk to Nixie, then watch my man beat the living shit out of Clay.
